full_list.title_en: Robust Bilayer Electronic Structure and Reduced Magnetic Exchange in La2SmNi2O7
full_list.title_zh: La2SmNi2O7 中稳健的双层电子结构和减少的磁交换
full_list.abstract: Rare-earth substitution provides an effective route to enhance superconductivity in bilayer nickelates, but its influence on the local electronic structure and magnetic exchange interactions remains unclear. Here we report Ni-L₃-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements on single crystals of La₂SmNi₂O₇, a Sm-substituted bilayer nickelate with enhanced in-plane lattice distortion and a reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. Despite these structural modifications, the local electronic excitations associated with NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer processes occur at essentially the same energies as in La₃Ni₂O₇, including features near 0.3~eV, 1.0~eV, and 1.5~eV. This shows that Sm substitution does not substantially alter the local NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer energy scales of the corner-shared bilayer. In contrast, high-resolution RIXS reveals well-defined spin-wave-like excitations whose band top is reduced by sim7~meV. A bilayer J_c-J₁-J₂ Heisenberg analysis of the spin excitation dispersion indicates an approximately 10% reduction of the effective magnetic exchange scale, which correlates with the reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. The small intrinsic damping of these modes further points to robust local-moment-like spin dynamics in the ambient-pressure parent phase.These results reveal a dichotomy in the response to Sm substitution, with largely preserved local electronic excitation energies but a reduced magnetic exchange scale. They identify the Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni geometry as an important structural parameter influencing magnetism in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates and provide spectroscopic constraints on microscopic models of high-T_c superconductivity in this family.

full_list.title_en: Study on Influence of Reaction time and process environment conditions on Heterogeneous Hydrogenation of HTPB using a Pd-Zr-charcoal catalyst

full_list.abstract: This paper outlines the influence of reactor environment conditions in synthesizing hydrogenated HTPB (HHTPB) using Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) polymer by catalytic hydrogenation method using bi-solvent system using iso-propyl alcohol and toluene as active solvent media. A novel synthesis approach to understand the effect of various reactor environment conditions such as nitrogen gas, H2 gas and hydrogen-air environments to hydrogenate HTPB using a catalyst made up of palladium and zirconium as base metals supported on activated charcoal was demonstrated. Experiments were conducted in a 100 mL Inconel made batch type reactor with a magnetically driven variable speed impeller. Optimization of process time is demonstrated and fixed as 6 h for the study. HTPB and HHTPB polymers were characterized by NMR, FTIR, and chemical analysis. The results showed that the degree of hydrogenation of HTPB is ~ 87.5% which is a waxy solid under hydrogen-air environment conditions for the given reactor volume with the chosen operating conditions. After hydrogenation of HTPB, no significant change in hydroxyl value was noticed, and the HHTPB formed is of vinyl-type functional isomer in H2 environment. A marginal increase in molecular weight was observed after hydrogenation in all cases. HTPB and HHTPB were subjected to TG- DSC studies and it was found that the thermal stability of HHTPB marginally increased.

full_list.title_en: A highway instead of a racetrack: Strong coupling of light and sound in an optical fiber
full_list.title_zh: 高速公路代替赛道：光纤中光与声的强耦合
full_list.abstract: For the first time, scientists have achieved strong coupling between light and long-lived acoustic vibrations in an optical fiber. Optical fibers are used in both classical telecommunications and quantum communication and could serve not only as connections between computing nodes but also as quantum processors themselves in the future. The results, published in Nature Physics, pave the way for new technologies in quantum signal processing.
full_list.abstract_zh: 科学家们首次在光纤中实现了光与长寿命声振动之间的强耦合。光纤用于经典电信和量子通信，不仅可以用作计算节点之间的连接，而且可以在未来用作量子处理器本身。研究结果发表在《自然物理学》上，为量子信号处理新技术铺平了道路。

full_list.title_en: Composition-structure-property relationships in thermally evaporated ZnS thin films and Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky barrier diodes

full_list.abstract: Nanostructured zinc sulphide (ZnS) thin films were deposited by thermal evaporation under high-vacuum conditions. We systematically investigated how film thickness and substrate temperature affect their structural, optical, and electrical properties. EDS and XPS analyses confirmed a near-stoichiometric to slightly Zn-rich composition, with Zn2+ and S2- as the predominant chemical states. Variations in Zn/S stoichiometry correlated with changes in the structural, optical, photoluminescence, and electrical properties of the ZnS films. X-ray diffraction confirmed the formation of cubic ZnS layers with a pronounced (111) preferred orientation and a lattice parameter of 5.396 Å. The 300 nm films deposited at 323 K exhibited a mean crystallite size of ~ 25 nm, microstrain of 1.45 × 10− 3, and dislocation density of 1.61 × 1015 m-2. The optimized film exhibited n-type conductivity with a mobility of 49.3 cm2 V-1 s-1, a resistivity of 2.35 × 10− 2 Ω cm, and a carrier concentration of 5.38 × 1018 cm-3. The films showed visible-region transparency up to 92%, direct bandgaps of 3.40–3.50 eV, and an absorption coefficient > 1 × 104 cm-1. Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky diodes exhibited rectifying characteristics, yielding barrier heights of 0.67 and 0.72 eV from I-V and C-V measurements, respectively, an ideality factor of 1.03, and a rectification ratio of 5.95. These findings support the potential of grown ZnS thin films as window/buffer layers in photovoltaic cells and in Schottky-barrier electronic applications.

full_list.title_en: Achieving simultaneous flame retardancy and mechanical reinforcement in PLA via PAPP/La 2 O 3 synergistic catalysis and uniaxial pre-stretching

full_list.abstract: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a promising bioplastic but its high flammability and poor toughness severely restrict its practical applications. Herein, we report a dual-strategy to simultaneously address these limitations by combining piperazine pyrophosphate (PAPP)/nano-La2O3 synergistic flame-retardant system with uniaxial pre-stretching post-treatment. Compared with pure PLA, the PLA composite containing 13 wt% PAPP and 2 wt% nano-La2O3 demonstrated the optimal performance, with an increase in LOI from 19.8% to 34.6% and achieving a UL‑94 V‑0 rating. Cone calorimetry revealed significant reductions in total heat release (from 79.6 to 27.8 MJ/m2) and peak heat release rate (from 368.0 to 185.6 kW/m2). Comprehensive char residue analyses (SEM, EDS, FTIR, Raman, XPS) confirmed that nano-La2O3 catalyzed the formation of a dense, highly graphitized carbon layer, effectively suppressing heat and mass transfer in the condensed phase, while gas-phase radical scavenging (PO·, PO₂·, HPO·) further interrupted combustion. Remarkably, uniaxial pre-stretching at 60°C transformed the brittle composites into ductile materials: the tensile strength of PLA/13%PAPP/2%La2O3 composite increased from 53.8 MPa to 67.4 MPa, and elongation at break dramatically increased from 4.8% to 84.5% (an 18-fold improvement). This work provides a feasible and effective strategy for developing high-performance flame-retardant PLA material with balanced fire safety and mechanical properties, offering great potential for packaging, electronics, and transportation applications.

full_list.title_zh: 用于非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 仅选择器存储器描述符引导设计的杂交离子度映射
full_list.abstract: Quantitative relationships among composition, bonding, and functional properties are essential for the rational design of amorphous chalcogenides. Here, we examine whether hybridization and ionicity, established composition-derived bonding descriptors, can guide selector-only memory (SOM) design. Mapping of reported SOM compositions reveals systematic correlations with the read-window margin (RWM) and identifies a favorable region for threshold-state differentiation. Guided by these trends, amorphous Ge–Sb–Se compositions with increasing Sb content were fabricated and evaluated, and all exhibited programmable SOM behavior with nonmonotonic electrical and reliability trends. Up to an intermediate Sb content, higher ionicity within an appropriate hybridization range increased polar heteropolar bonding, enlarged trap-energy separation and RWM, and improved threshold-voltage stability and endurance. Further Sb incorporation increased hybridization beyond the favorable range and promoted Sb–Sb-rich homopolar bonding, reducing trap-state differentiation and memory performance. X-ray photoelectron and Raman spectroscopy confirmed the corresponding bonding evolution, while temperature-dependent transport analyses linked these changes to trap energetics. These results establish a composition–bonding–trap–property relationship and show that hybridization–ionicity mapping can narrow candidate compositions before extensive fabrication and characterization.

full_list.title_en: Integrating GIS and machine learning for pollution vulnerability mapping in South Africa’s Kruger National Park
full_list.title_zh: 集成 GIS 和机器学习来绘制南非克鲁格国家公园的污染脆弱性地图
full_list.abstract: Pollution in protected areas can affect ecosystem integrity, biodiversity conservation, and the long-term sustainability of natural resource management. This study developed an integrated GIS and machine learning framework to assess and map pollution vulnerability in South Africa’s Kruger National Park (KNP). Environmental and atmospheric variables, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), methane (CH₄), particulate matter (PM₂.₅), rainfall, and temperature, were integrated within Google Earth Engine and Python-based analytical environments. Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) algorithms were applied to classify spatial patterns of pollution vulnerability and identify the variables contributing most strongly to the observed patterns. The results showed that GBM achieved an overall classification accuracy of 0.76, while RF produced an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.96 and SVM achieved an AUC of 0.90. SO₂ and NO₂ were among the most influential variables in the modelling framework, indicating the importance of atmospheric pollution indicators in explaining spatial variations in vulnerability. The resulting vulnerability maps identified areas with moderate to high pollution vulnerability that can support targeted environmental monitoring and conservation planning. By integrating remote sensing, GIS, and machine learning, the study provides a spatial decision-support framework for sustainable environmental management in a large, protected area. The findings contribute particularly to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 15 (Life on Land) through improved protection and management of terrestrial ecosystems, while also supporting SDG 13 (Climate Action) through climate-sensitive environmental planning and contributing to SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) through improved management of environmental pollution.

core_items.title_en: Robust Bilayer Electronic Structure and Reduced Magnetic Exchange in La2SmNi2O7
core_items.title_zh: La2SmNi2O7 中稳健的双层电子结构和减少的磁交换
core_items.abstract: Rare-earth substitution provides an effective route to enhance superconductivity in bilayer nickelates, but its influence on the local electronic structure and magnetic exchange interactions remains unclear. Here we report Ni-L₃-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements on single crystals of La₂SmNi₂O₇, a Sm-substituted bilayer nickelate with enhanced in-plane lattice distortion and a reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. Despite these structural modifications, the local electronic excitations associated with NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer processes occur at essentially the same energies as in La₃Ni₂O₇, including features near 0.3~eV, 1.0~eV, and 1.5~eV. This shows that Sm substitution does not substantially alter the local NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer energy scales of the corner-shared bilayer. In contrast, high-resolution RIXS reveals well-defined spin-wave-like excitations whose band top is reduced by sim7~meV. A bilayer J_c-J₁-J₂ Heisenberg analysis of the spin excitation dispersion indicates an approximately 10% reduction of the effective magnetic exchange scale, which correlates with the reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. The small intrinsic damping of these modes further points to robust local-moment-like spin dynamics in the ambient-pressure parent phase.These results reveal a dichotomy in the response to Sm substitution, with largely preserved local electronic excitation energies but a reduced magnetic exchange scale. They identify the Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni geometry as an important structural parameter influencing magnetism in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates and provide spectroscopic constraints on microscopic models of high-T_c superconductivity in this family.
core_items.abstract_zh: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。尽管进行了这些结构修改，与 NiO₆ 晶体场和电荷转移过程相关的局域电子激发的能量基本上与 La₃Ni2O₇ 中相同，包括接近 0.3~eV、1.0~eV 和 1.5~eV 的特征。这表明 Sm 取代并没有显着改变局部 NiO6 晶体场和角共享双层的电荷转移能级。相比之下，高分辨率 RIXS 揭示了定义明确的类自旋波激发，其带顶降低了 sim7~meV。自旋激发色散的双层 J_c-J1-J2 海森堡分析表明有效磁交换规模减少了约 10%，这与层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP-Ni 键角的减小相关。这些模式的小固有阻尼进一步表明环境压力母相中具有强大的类局部矩自旋动力学。这些结果揭示了对 Sm 替代的响应的二分性，局部电子激发能大部分保留，但磁交换规模减小。他们将 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 几何形状确定为影响 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐磁性的重要结构参数，并为该族高温超导微观模型提供了光谱约束。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《超薄磁有序Ni(001)/Fe 0.2 Ni 0.8 /Ni(001)和Ni(001)/Fe 0.3 Ni 0.7 /Ni(001)纳米结中的弹道磁子输运》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
